pages.title: Up and Down
pages.text: Flow and buoyancy help manage water and depth.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The Drain needs liquid above and empty space below. Gossamer Worm Bioluminessence makes Floaters, underwater torches and Glowing potions. Light and glowing creatures attract Hullbreakers.
